race.comment: STITZER (10) was well backed first up at Kembla Grange but was too bad to be true when getting pulled up in the lane. Has since gone back to the trials where he was pushed right out behind a few smart ones. Blinkers go on and Lloyd takes over. Sharp improvement anticipated. PRESUMPTUOUS GAL (8) was a big improver second up at Newcastle when charging home hard to just miss the bob over the mile. The rise to 1800m third up looks perfect for her now. GENTLE GIANT (1) gave a bold sight on debut at Kembla Grange, only to be collared late. He's sure to have come on from that and gets Hyeronimus taking over. Expect them to hunt forward again and prove tougher to run down. ROULADEN (4) boasts a fitness edge and should land up on speed again. Should be in this for a long way and is a top-three chance.
